newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos says Queensland well flows gas.
newsitem.headline: Santos says Queensland well flows gas.

text.p: Petroleum explorer and producer Santos Ltd said on Wednesday its Thoar-2 gas appraisal well in south-west Queensland had proved successful.

Santos said in a statement the well in the Queensland sector of the Cooper/Eromanga Basins flowed gas at a rate of 7.3 million cubic feet per day, with 51 barrels of condensate per day over the interval 2,030 metres to 2,040 metres.
The test was conducted through half-inch surface choke.
Thoar 2 is 1.9 km south-east of Thoar 1 and about 70 km south of the Ballera Gas Centre.
Santos is the operator and has a 58.8625 percent interest in the well.

Other participants are Exxon Corp unit Delhi Petroleum with 23.2 percent, Boral Ltd's Boral Energy Resources Ltd with 16.5 percent, Australian Hydrocarbons Ltd on 1.2 percent and Oil Co of Australia Ltd with 0.2375 percent.
